title: Regulating AI 'not the right place to start' says Bailey
summary: Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey argues that regulating artificial intelligence is not the appropriate starting point, emphasizing the need for rigorous testing and safeguards to manage AI risks.

title: Best AI Tools for Photographers in 2026
summary: The article reviews the most effective AI-powered applications available to photographers in 2026, covering tools for image editing, organization, and creative enhancement. It highlights how these solutions streamline workflow, improve productivity, and enable new artistic possibilities for both amateurs and professionals.

title: Practical Secrets Extraction against Black-box LLMs
summary: The paper introduces a black‑box framework for extracting confidential credentials that large language models may have memorized, even when only output access is available. It combines cross‑validated secret knowledge distillation to build a local proxy model and proxy‑guided extraction techniques using entropy and structural priors. Experiments on controlled benchmarks and real‑world API services (OpenAI and Claude Code) demonstrate higher recovery rates and lower latency than prior methods, highlighting a tangible risk of credential leakage from commercial LLMs.
